description: Consolidate off-convention test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts into canonical test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (mirror convention), faithful carry-over with zero coverage loss.

userStories.title: Merge off-convention orch-recycle-watch tests into the canonical file and delete the original
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the 11 backstop tests that CAM-163 US-003 landed in test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts moved into the canonical test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts so that both suites testing src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts live in one mirror-convention location with zero coverage loss.
acceptanceCriteria: All 11 top-level tests from test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts are carried into test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts, wrapped in their own describe block; the off-convention file has 0 describe blocks so the 11 tests must be wrapped when merged. [oracle: file-assert grep -c 'test(' test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts shows the combined count (canonical 17 + carried 11)]

The carried tests include the emitEventFn/unresolved-pid cases and the ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION cases the canonical file did not previously cover. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION' test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts]

The module import is retargeted from ../src/... to ../../src/...: runOrchRecycleWatch from ../../src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts, ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION from ../../src/orchestrator/context-window.ts, and the inline require of ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER from ../../src/tmux/session.ts. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q "from '\.\./src/" test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts]
The off-convention file test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts is deleted. [oracle: file-assert test ! -f test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts]

The carried tests keep their own runOneTick helper and its '__stop_loop__' sentinel; the canonical helpers and canonical '__test_stop__' sentinel are not forcibly unified with them, and semantic overlaps (marker->SIGTERM, marker-consumed, no-kill-when-pid-null) are NOT deduped. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '__stop_loop__' test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts && grep -q '__test_stop__' test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test) with the combined assertion count preserved. [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: SOURCE test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (12KB, 11 top-level tests, 0 describe blocks, uses runOneTick helper with '__stop_loop__' sentinel); TARGET test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (16KB, 4 describe blocks, canonical helpers with '__test_stop__' sentinel). Both test src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts. Faithful carry-over only: no dedup of semantic overlaps, no unification of helpers or sentinels. Retarget imports from ../ to ../../ : module (../../src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts), ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION (../../src/orchestrator/context-window.ts, NOT ../../src/context-window.ts), inline require ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER (../../src/tmux/session.ts, line ~363 in source). GOTCHA: two distinct stop sentinels ('__stop_loop__' off-convention vs '__test_stop__' canonical) - keep each helper with its own; mixing risks swallowing a real error or rethrowing a stop signal. GOTCHA: off-convention tests import ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION and pass it as backstopFraction; canonical hardcodes 0.8 - carry the import over, do not rewrite to hardcode. No literal name/title collisions exist between the two files.
